description: Utility functions and constants for testing, including UUID generation, timing, color conversion, and Playwright project directory detection.

methods.name: loadUuid
methods.description: Dynamically imports the 'uuid' package and caches the v4 function.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Asynchronously waits for a specified number of milliseconds.

methods.name: getRandomId
methods.description: Generates a random ID string of specified length using UUID v4.

methods.name: hexToRgb
methods.description: Converts a hex color code to an RGB string.

methods.name: findPlaywrightRoot
methods.description: Searches upward from current directory to find the Playwright root directory based on config files.

methods.name: resolvePlaywrightPath
methods.description: Resolves a directory path relative to the Playwright root, or current working directory if not found.
